This version takes out the WebUntis import until Untis approves Meldo as an integration partner. Untis allows its interface only for school-internal projects, so Meldo waits for approval before it connects again. If you already have Meldo, install this version over it. Your data stays.

## What's new

- **WebUntis import: waiting for approval from Untis.** The WebUntis page under More and the button in the tour stay, but they are not available in this version or upcoming versions until Untis approves. You type your timetable in yourself until then.
- **Data from WebUntis stays.** A timetable, exams and other data imported by an earlier version stay on your phone and in your encrypted Google Drive backup. They are no longer updated.
- **Gone for now:** Abwesenheiten, excuse notes, Ferien and the holiday widget, and the Start cards for exams, news and absences. They only worked with data from WebUntis.

## How to install

Download **`Meldo-0.0.2.5.apk`** under **Assets** below, open it and tap **Install**. If you have an earlier version, this updates it without losing your data. On a new phone, allow installs from your browser or Files app when Android asks. You need Android 8 or newer.

## Found a bug?

Please open an issue at [github.com/Meldo-dev/meldo-android/issues](https://github.com/Meldo-dev/meldo-android/issues). For security problems, follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Meldo-dev/meldo-android/blob/main/SECURITY.md) instead.

## Kurz auf Deutsch

WebUntis-Anbindung: wartet auf Freigabe durch Untis. In dieser Version und in den kommenden Versionen ist der WebUntis-Import nicht verfügbar, bis Untis ihn freigibt; bis dahin trägst du deinen Stundenplan selbst ein. Bereits geladene Daten bleiben erhalten. Abwesenheiten, Entschuldigungen, Ferien und das Ferien-Widget sind vorerst weg, weil sie nur mit WebUntis funktioniert haben. Installiere `Meldo-0.0.2.5.apk` einfach über die alte Version, deine Daten bleiben erhalten.
